intro: Estonia has produced champions in wrestling, rally driving, skiing and decathlon.

chapters.title: Champions
text: Erki Nool won Olympic decathlon gold in 2000, and Ott Tänak became World Rally Champion in 2019. Basketball and cross-country skiing are popular.

chapters.title: Wrestling
text: Wrestling has a long tradition; Kristjan Palusalu won two Olympic golds in 1936, and Estonian wrestlers have competed at the top level ever since.

keyTerms.meaning: An athletics contest of ten events.
